{"triples": [{"subject": "Neural Language Models", "predicate": "uses", "object": "word-level embeddings", "object_type": "Other", "source_sentence": "Our architecture, however, uses neural language models for modeling lemmas and diacritized forms, and utilizes the word-level embeddings in various configurations to combat noise , as explained throughout the rest of the paper."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphological tagging", "object_type": "Task", "source_sentence": "We use an LSTM-based architecture for morphological tagging and language modeling for the various morphological features in EGY."}, {"subject": "LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "language modeling", "object_type": "Task", "source_sentence": "We use an LSTM-based architecture for morphological tagging and language modeling for the various morphological features in EGY."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "Bi-LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphological feature tagging tasks", "object_type": "Task", "source_sentence": "Overall Architecture We use Bi-LSTM-based taggers for the morphological feature tagging tasks."}, {"subject": "LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "relevant context", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "We use two LSTM layers to model the relevant context for both directions of the target word, where the input is represented by the vi vectors mentioned above."}, {"subject": "Softmax", "predicate": "uses", "object": "probability distribution", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "We join both sides, apply a non-linearity function, and softmax to get a probability distribution."}, {"subject": "Convolutional Neural Networks", "predicate": "uses", "object": "character embedding vectors", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "Character Embedding We use convolutional neural networks (CNN) and LSTM-based architectures for the character embedding vectors vci, both applied to the character sequence within each word separately."}, {"subject": "LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "character embedding vectors", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "Character Embedding We use convolutional neural networks (CNN) and LSTM-based architectures for the character embedding vectors vci, both applied to the character sequence within each word separately."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "LSTM", "predicate": "uses", "object": "last state vector", "object_type": "Other", "source_sentence": "For the LSTM-based architecture we use the last state vector as the embedding representation of the word's characters."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "word2vec", "predicate": "uses", "object": "Gensim implementation", "object_type": "Other", "source_sentence": "We use the Word2vec framework in the Gensim implementation (Rehurek and Sojka, 2010) to generate the embedding spaces."}, {"subject": "embeddings", "predicate": "uses", "object": "cosine distance", "object_type": "Metric", "source_sentence": "We use these embeddings to learn and score normalization candidates based on their cosine distance as a semantic score, and edit distance as a lexical score."}, {"subject": "embeddings", "predicate": "uses", "object": "edit distance", "object_type": "Metric", "source_sentence": "We use these embeddings to learn and score normalization candidates based on their cosine distance as a semantic score, and edit distance as a lexical score."}]}
